title.zh: 将宿务省Moalboal市镇Moalboal省立中学改设为国立渔业学校，名称为Moalboal南宿务渔业学校，并授权为此拨款
title.en: An Act to Convert the Moalboal Provincial High School in the Municipality of Moalboal, Province of Cebu, into a National School of Fisheries, to be Known as the Moalboal Southern Cebu School of Fisheries and to Authorize the Appropriations of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Moalboal Provincial High School in the Municipality of Moalboal, Province of Cebu, into a National School of Fisheries, to be Known as the Moalboal Southern Cebu School of Fisheries and to Authorize the Appropriations of Funds Therefor

text.en: The Moalboal Provincial High School located in the Municipality of Moalboal, Province of Cebu, is hereby converted into a national school of fisheries, to be known as the Moalboal Southern Cebu National School of Fisheries and to be headed by a fishery school principal. The Secretary of Education is hereby empowered to reorganize said school accordingly.

The sum of two hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as additional appropriation to carry out the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
